==Behind the scenes==
The blash'narl was mentioned in ''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]'', [[Michael Allen Horne]]'s [[1993]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Corporate" />
